title: Adaptive context: replay versus auto, Opus 5.5, Agent Obstacle Course (course-000 and T4)
summary: Pre-registered A/B of --context-profile replay vs auto with prompt caching on and durable state on: course-000 5 runs per arm, T4 3 runs per arm. auto did not reduce total input tokens or cost; on T4 it escalated to Deep in every run because the injected transient test failure counted as conflicting evidence.

results.t4_pass: replay 3/3, auto 2/3 (the FAIL: one course-fixture regression test, unresolved)

comparability: Paired replay vs auto on the same build, course version, model and settings; not comparable with the 2026-10-28 batch (build 35d7af2, no prompt caching, --no-state) or with other registry entries.
limitations: 5+5 and 3+3 runs: a screen, not proof
auto's T4 runs were dominated by a selector defect (transient infrastructure failure treated as conflicting evidence)
the T4 course's agent-visible suite includes an audit snapshot the evaluator excludes, so the agent never verifies on T4
cost computed from provider-reported token counts at listed prices; no provider-reported dollar figure

reproduce.command: in rkendel1/agent-obstacle: npm run experiment:ab -- --launch --stage <course-000|t4> --confirm-paid (paid model calls)
